about.title: About QazaqTrip
about.subtitle: An IT product that uses the Kazakh language: a guide for foreign tourists, in Kazakh.
about.goal_text: QazaqTrip was made for the regional contest “IT products for using the Kazakh language”. The goal: bring the Kazakh language and culture closer to foreign tourists — so that a guest can say hello in Kazakh, ask about prices and find their way around a museum. The MVP fully covers one city — Kyzylorda; the other cities are “coming soon” cards.

tech.name: React + Vite + TypeScript
tech.desc: Structured, fast interface; types catch errors before they ship.

tech.name: Tailwind CSS
tech.desc: Mobile-first design: verified down to a 360px screen.

tech.name: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap
tech.desc: Open map with no API key: pins for sights and hotels.

tech.name: Serverless API (Vercel / Netlify)
tech.desc: The /api/guide function — the API key lives on the server only, never in the browser.

tech.name: OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) + demo mode
tech.desc: Without a key, the guide builds the itinerary locally from the JSON — the app never goes down.

about.ai_text: When you send a request, the server sends the FULL kyzylorda.json file into the system prompt of /api/guide. The rules: only the places, prices and hours from the file; a null value is reported as “not specified”, never guessed; opening hours are respected (the museum is closed on Mondays, lunch break); the Baikonur permit warning is mandatory; the answer is in Kazakh or your chosen language, with 1–2 Kazakh phrases and translations; it ends with a day-by-day timeline and a budget summary.
about.footer_note: Prices and hours come from public sources and may change.
